 The CA Foundation scorecard will also be made available the official website, caresults.icai.org. The CA Foundation September 2026 examination was conducted on September 2, 5, 7 and 9 in offline mode.
 ICAI announced the expected CA Foundation September 2026 results through an official notification issued on November 1. Candidates will need their registration number and roll number to access the ICAI CA Foundation Result 2026.

 CA Foundation Result 2026: How to download scorecard?
 Candidates can follow these steps to check their result:
 Visit the official result website, caresults.icai.org
 On the homepage, click on the link for the CA Foundation September 2026 result
 Enter the registration and roll number
 Submit the details to view the result
 Check the marks and qualifying status displayed on the screen
 Download the scorecard and save a copy for future reference
 Candidates must verify the details mentioned on their CA Foundation scorecard 2026 after downloading it.

 CA Foundation pass percentage
 The overall pass percentage of ICAI CA Foundation Result 2026 is different from the individual passing criteria. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in each paper and 50% in aggregate to clear the CA Foundation examination.
 The pass percentage of the CA Foundation Result September 2026 represents the proportion of candidates who qualified for the examination out of the total number who appeared.
